title: One Checkpoint, Four Converters: Per Input Disagreement After On Device Conversion and a Probe Set That Catches It
abstract: arXiv:2611.29661v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A model converted for on device or accelerated inference ships once its top 1 accuracy matches the source model. Accuracy can match while individual decisions change, and the converter, its INT8 recipe and its calibration draw each move them. We convert 5 public checkpoints (four ImageNet classifiers and a sentiment model) with the documented FP32 and INT8 recipes of ExecuTorch, LiteRT, ONNX Runtime and TensorRT and compare every top 1 decision with the PyTorch source on 7,854 images and 1,938 sentences. All 34 strict FP32 conversions reproduce every decision, yet each of the 4 vision INT8 recipes that keeps accuracy equivalent flips more than 1% of decisions: ONNX Runtime static INT8 flips 4.07% (95% CI [3.65, 4.53]) of ResNet 50 decisions while accuracy moves by -0.15 points, and two builds of that recipe from different calibration draws disagree on 3.44% [3.06, 3.88]. Where accuracy is kept, the flipped inputs are the ones the source

translated_title: 同一检查点，四种转换器：端侧转换后的逐输入分歧及捕捉它的探测集
translated_abstract: 为设备端或加速推理而转换的模型，通常在其top-1准确率与源模型匹配后即可发布。然而准确率匹配的同时，个别输入的决策可能已经改变，且转换器本身、其INT8量化方案及其校准过程都会各自移动这些决策。作者使用ExecuTorch、LiteRT、ONNX Runtime和TensorRT文档记载的FP32与INT8方案转换了5个公开检查点（四个ImageNet分类器和一个情感模型），并在7,854张图像和1,938条句子上将每个top-1决策与PyTorch源模型逐一比较。结果显示，所有34次严格FP32转换均完整复现了源模型的每一个决策，然而保持准确率等效的4个视觉INT8方案中，每一个都翻转了超过1%的决策：ONNX Runtime静态INT8方案使ResNet-50的4.07%（95%置信区间 [3.65, 4.53]）决策发生翻转，而准确率仅变动-0.15个百分点；同一方案在不同校准抽样下的两次构建，彼此之间在3.44% [3.06, 3.88]的样本上不一致。在准确率保持的情况下，被翻转的输入正是源模型……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究揭示了一个被忽视的问题：INT8量化转换后的模型即使整体准确率与源模型相当，仍有超过1%的单个输入预测决策发生翻转且随转换器和校准抽样而变化，并据此构建了一个能够捕捉这种逐输入分歧的探测集。
en_tdlr: Even when on-device INT8-converted models match source-model accuracy, over 1% of individual input decisions flip—varying across converters and calibration draws—and the paper introduces a probe set that catches this per-input disagreement.
